pages.text: These artifacts are in the Ra Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Ra to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
Helmet of Ra. Equip it together with the Body, Legs, and Feet to activate the set bonus.
Chestplate of Ra. Complete the set for Fire Resistance.
Leggings of Ra. The Fire Resistance effect requires all four pieces.
Boots of Ra. The complete set grants Fire Resistance and completes Ra-dy for Action.
A bow that fires burning arrows. It is most useful against foes that are vulnerable to fire.
Equip this ring in Curios. When walking on solid ground near source lava, it can briefly turn nearby lava into Ra Stone. Keep moving before the temporary stepping stones melt.
